name: rngdle-automation
description: Astro control dashboard and durable RNGdle automation on Cloudflare Workers.

RNGDLE_EMAIL.description: RNGdle account email. Store as a Worker secret.

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server hostname. Set as a Workers Builds variable.

SMTP_USER.description: SMTP login account. Store as a Worker secret.

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: SMTP credential for password authentication. Store as a Worker secret.

MAIL_TO.description: Comma-separated result email recipients. Store as a Worker secret.

MIGRATION_TOKEN.description: Random management token used by the `pnpm cloudflare` commands. Generate it with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

CONTROL_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL for the Control page. For a custom deployment, set this as a Workers Builds variable.

ALLOW_SETUP.description: Set to `true` for a fresh deployment, then `false` after creating the Control password.

WORKER_NAME.description: Optional Workers Builds variable used to override the Worker name without editing the repository.

CUSTOM_DOMAIN.description: Optional Workers Builds variable hostname. When set, the generated configuration uses this custom domain route.

ZONE_NAME.description: Cloudflare zone name, required when `CUSTOM_DOMAIN` is set.
